library(shiny)
library(seriation)
ui<-fluidPage(
 
  plotOutput("image")
  )
server <- function(input,output){
  output$image <- renderPlot({
    z<-matrix(c(1:100),10,10)

d <- dist(z)

o <- seriate(d)

pimage(d,o,main = "Reordered by ARSA", col = c(
"red","pink","orange","violet"
,"yellow","green","cyan","blue"), prop =
TRUE, axes="both")
    )})
}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
